criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered in a real world, frame 7 best, frame 1 a credible cover. Frame 6 cannot be read as a vial and its flies read as ants in a ring over a dead lower left. Frame 5 looks like a game level with flat UI bars and a cropped vial. Frame 4 mostly dead wall with a pinned page. Frame 3's monitor floats and the dek sits on its edge. The hero is under a tenth of the frame height on 2, 3, 4, 9. The exterior coping has no contact or dirt.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero, building, light and grade, both devices working, bookends hold. The value strobes with five hard cuts, only one declared. Frames 4 and 6 sit outside the look, 1/8 and 2/9 repeat compositions, frame 9 lost the chair.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, bar ratio and flags match, frame 5 careful. The caption opener is an editorial negative, frame 7's heights are positions no frame says are not a scale.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and what to do with eligibility, terms and address. The AI's role at its true size. Concrete and actionable.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, frame 2 pays, the turn at 6 and payoff at 7, close on an action. Frame 8's picture repeats frame 1.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain, on register, good lines. Thin Texas detail, frame 2's dek release-flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New beat and a new outdoor-indoor split. The opening move repeats no. 39's.

one_sentence_fix: Bring the camera to the vial on frames 2, 3, 4 and 9 and re-stage frame 6 so the vial owns a third of each frame with its glass, plug and winged flies legible at 432 px.
artwork_defects: 1. Frame 6, the turn, fails as a picture: no glass wall, rim or plug reads, the food looks like a freestanding cork cylinder, the flies sit in a ring with no visible wings and read as ants or beads, the lower left half is a dead zone.
2. The hero does not own frames 2, 3, 4 and 9: the vial is 8 to 10 percent of the frame height.
3. Frame 5 looks like a game engine: scatter-card trees on a dark plane, a flat lavender parapet, tapes as UI bars, the vial cropped with no shadow across the tapes.
4. The exterior ground has no contact and no dirt: the coping on 1, 7 and 8 is a smooth plane with one highlight streak.
5. Frame 4 is mostly dead wall with a page pinned against nothing.
6. Frame 3's monitor floats with no neck above a black slab, and the dek sits against its top edge.
7. Frames 1/8 and 2/9 repeat two compositions, frame 9 lost the empty chair.
8. The value strobes, five hard cuts, one declared.
9. Type details: a descender touching on frame 5, mixed apostrophe glyphs between the display and dek faces.
